description: email_send: from_address and from_name are part of the compatible key set, and the rule is explicit - a relay that cannot honour a field fails with not_supported, NEVER drops it silently. A message that went out from the wrong sender is not recoverable by re-running it.
notes: The refusal branch of the sender rule. A relay that cannot set the sender fails the step naming the field; it never sends from a different one, because a message that went out from the wrong sender is not recoverable by re-running the step. The honoured branch is snippets.email_send.a_declared_sender_is_honoured, and neither is complete without the other.
